theorem compact_cutoff_of_geometry {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (F : X n → ℝ) (phi : OpenPartialHomeomorph (X n) (E k × E (n-k)))
    (T : Set (E k × E (n-k))) (U : Set (X n)) (c : ℝ) (x0 : X n)
    (hgeo : LocalGeometry F phi T U c x0) (hsource : U ⊆ phi.source)
    (hrad : MorseCone.radiusBall ρ ⊆ T) : CompactGeometry hk ρ hρ F phi T U x0 := by

theorem actual_source_compact_cutoff {n : ℕ} {L : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)]
    (omega : I4Source.SourceMode n → ℝ)
    (hmajor : Summable (fun m => I4Source.modeMajorant n L m * |omega m|))
    (x0 : X n) (hdet : (PhysicalSpectral.hessian (L := L) omega x0).det ≠ 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) x0 = 0) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (P : E n ≃L[ℝ] X n) (s : Sym n → Sym n)
      (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E n) (E n))
      (D : MorseCone.NormalForm (I4Torus.SourceTorus n L) (E k) (E (n-k))),
      let J := PhysicalSpectral.signSym n k
      let M := TaylorSymLift.sourceSymMatrix (L := L) omega x0 P.toContinuousLinearMap
      M 0 = J ∧ (∀ u, e u = theta J s M u) ∧
      e 0 = 0 ∧ e.symm 0 = 0 ∧ 0 ∈ e.source ∧ 0 ∈ e.target ∧
      HasFDerivAt e (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E n)) 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e.symm e.target ∧
      D.f = I4Torus.torusSourceField n L omega ∧
      D.p = I4Torus.torusProjection n L x0 ∧ D.c = I4Source.sourceField n L omega x0 ∧
      D.chart = (liftChart (L := L) x0).trans (physicalChart hk x0 P e) ∧
      (∀ q, D.chart q = split hk (e (P.symm (liftChart (L := L) x0 q - x0)))) ∧
      (∀ z, D.chart.symm z = I4Torus.torusProjection n L (x0 + P (e.symm ((split hk).symm z)))) ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 2 D.chart D.chart.source ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 2 D.chart.symm D.chart.target ∧
      LocalGeometry (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) (physicalChart hk x0 P e)
        D.chart.target ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target)
        D.c x0 ∧
      CompactGeometry hk D.ρ D.hρ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega)
        (physicalChart hk x0 P e) D.chart.target
        ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target) x0 := by

theorem compact_cutoff_of_geometry {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (F : X n → ℝ) (phi : OpenPartialHomeomorph (X n) (E k × E (n-k)))
    (T : Set (E k × E (n-k))) (U : Set (X n)) (c : ℝ) (x0 : X n)
    (hgeo : LocalGeometry F phi T U c x0) (hsource : U ⊆ phi.source)
    (hrad : MorseCone.radiusBall ρ ⊆ T) : CompactGeometry hk ρ hρ F phi T U x0 := by

theorem actual_source_compact_cutoff {n : ℕ} {L : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)]
    (omega : I4Source.SourceMode n → ℝ)
    (hmajor : Summable (fun m => I4Source.modeMajorant n L m * |omega m|))
    (x0 : X n) (hdet : (PhysicalSpectral.hessian (L := L) omega x0).det ≠ 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) x0 = 0) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (P : E n ≃L[ℝ] X n) (s : Sym n → Sym n)
      (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E n) (E n))
      (D : MorseCone.NormalForm (I4Torus.SourceTorus n L) (E k) (E (n-k))),
      let J := PhysicalSpectral.signSym n k
      let M := TaylorSymLift.sourceSymMatrix (L := L) omega x0 P.toContinuousLinearMap
      M 0 = J ∧ (∀ u, e u = theta J s M u) ∧
      e 0 = 0 ∧ e.symm 0 = 0 ∧ 0 ∈ e.source ∧ 0 ∈ e.target ∧
      HasFDerivAt e (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E n)) 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e.symm e.target ∧
      D.f = I4Torus.torusSourceField n L omega ∧
      D.p = I4Torus.torusProjection n L x0 ∧ D.c = I4Source.sourceField n L omega x0 ∧
      D.chart = (liftChart (L := L) x0).trans (physicalChart hk x0 P e) ∧
      (∀ q, D.chart q = split hk (e (P.symm (liftChart (L := L) x0 q - x0)))) ∧
      (∀ z, D.chart.symm z = I4Torus.torusProjection n L (x0 + P (e.symm ((split hk).symm z)))) ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 2 D.chart D.chart.source ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 2 D.chart.symm D.chart.target ∧
      LocalGeometry (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) (physicalChart hk x0 P e)
        D.chart.target ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target)
        D.c x0 ∧
      CompactGeometry hk D.ρ D.hρ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega)
        (physicalChart hk x0 P e) D.chart.target
        ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target) x0 := by

theorem compact_cutoff_of_geometry {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (F : X n → ℝ) (phi : OpenPartialHomeomorph (X n) (E k × E (n-k)))
    (T : Set (E k × E (n-k))) (U : Set (X n)) (c : ℝ) (x0 : X n)
    (hgeo : LocalGeometry F phi T U c x0) (hsource : U ⊆ phi.source)
    (hrad : MorseCone.radiusBall ρ ⊆ T) : CompactGeometry hk ρ hρ F phi T U x0 := by

theorem actual_source_compact_cutoff {n : ℕ} {L : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)]
    (omega : I4Source.SourceMode n → ℝ)
    (hmajor : Summable (fun m => I4Source.modeMajorant n L m * |omega m|))
    (x0 : X n) (hdet : (PhysicalSpectral.hessian (L := L) omega x0).det ≠ 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) x0 = 0) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (P : E n ≃L[ℝ] X n) (s : Sym n → Sym n)
      (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E n) (E n))
      (D : MorseCone.NormalForm (I4Torus.SourceTorus n L) (E k) (E (n-k))),
      let J := PhysicalSpectral.signSym n k
      let M := TaylorSymLift.sourceSymMatrix (L := L) omega x0 P.toContinuousLinearMap
      M 0 = J ∧ (∀ u, e u = theta J s M u) ∧
      e 0 = 0 ∧ e.symm 0 = 0 ∧ 0 ∈ e.source ∧ 0 ∈ e.target ∧
      HasFDerivAt e (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E n)) 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e.symm e.target ∧
      D.f = I4Torus.torusSourceField n L omega ∧
      D.p = I4Torus.torusProjection n L x0 ∧ D.c = I4Source.sourceField n L omega x0 ∧
      D.chart = (liftChart (L := L) x0).trans (physicalChart hk x0 P e) ∧
      (∀ q, D.chart q = split hk (e (P.symm (liftChart (L := L) x0 q - x0)))) ∧
      (∀ z, D.chart.symm z = I4Torus.torusProjection n L (x0 + P (e.symm ((split hk).symm z)))) ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 2 D.chart D.chart.source ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E k × E (n-k)) 𝓘(ℝ, X n) 2 D.chart.symm D.chart.target ∧
      LocalGeometry (I4Source.sourceField n L omega) (physicalChart hk x0 P e)
        D.chart.target ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target)
        D.c x0 ∧
      CompactGeometry hk D.ρ D.hρ (I4Source.sourceField n L omega)
        (physicalChart hk x0 P e) D.chart.target
        ((physicalChart hk x0 P e).source ∩ (liftChart (L := L) x0).target) x0 := by

source_statements.text: Proposed mathematical theorem: for a finite-dimensional real Euclidean E, smooth f near p, Df(p)=0, and the literal symmetric Hessian admitting such a complementary definite split, the subtype S={z:f(z)>=f(p)} has a basis of relatively open path-connected neighborhoods at p. Combining this pointwise result with the existing regular/interior theorem would yield closed-superlevel LPC at every point for a literal smooth Morse function. Actual quotient transport and C294 consumption still require their own exact joins.

Translate p=0 and subtract f(p). Via the finite-dimensional complementary linear homeomorphism W×V -> E, write F(x,y)=f(x+y)-f(0), x in positive W and y in negative V. The C2 Hessian is symmetric; its restriction C to V is negative definite and hence an invertible map V -> V*. The implicit function theorem applied to partial_y F(x,y)=0 gives a smooth local map g:W -> V, g(0)=0, with partial_y F(x,g(x))=0. Empty negative dimension is allowed: V={0}, g=0 and the partial-gradient equation is trivial.

Let h(x)=F(x,g(x)). Then h(0)=0 and Dh(0)=0. For w in W, put v=Dg(0)w. Differentiating the ridge equation gives
H(w+v,z)=0 for every z in V,
so H(w,v)=-H(v,v). The chain rule at the critical point gives
D2h(0)[w,w]=H(w+v,w+v)=H(w,w)-H(v,v)>0 for w!=0.
The final strict inequality follows from positive definiteness on W and nonpositivity on V; no cross-block orthogonality is assumed. Consequently, after shrinking to a convex W ball, h has uniformly positive Hessian and h(x)>=0 there. This also covers W={0}, where h is the single value0 and the strict-positive condition is vacuous.

because the first endpoint lies in S and the ridge value h(x)>=0. The second path t -> (1-t)x+g((1-t)x) remains in U and S since its value is h((1-t)x)>=0. Their concatenation connects z to0 within U intersect S. Thus U intersect S is path connected and relatively open, and the arbitrary-neighborhood containment supplies the required basis.

For a local maximum W={0}, the same argument actually gives U intersect S={0} from strict fiber concavity. For a local minimum V={0}, U intersect S=U after shrinking, by h>=0. In dimension0 both are the singleton case. These cases must be explicit in a Lean implementation; no nonzero unit sphere may be assumed in a zero-dimensional subspace.

records.source_hypotheses: E is a finite-dimensional real Euclidean space and f is smooth near p with Df(p) = 0. The Hessian admits complementary subspaces V (negative definite) and W (positive definite), as in Lifetime's HessianHasInertia, not required to be Hessian-orthogonal (lines 7, 9). Zero subspaces and dimension 0 are allowed (lines 15, 21, 33).
